name: Zámrsk (Czechia)
description: Dark red field with a yellow pall issuing from the hoist corners to the centre of the fly, and a yellow crown with white pearls at the hoist.
history: Granted by decision of the Chairman of the Chamber of Deputies of the Czech Parliament on 14 March 2002 and entered in the Register of Municipal Symbols (REKOS); the flag repeats the colours and charges of the municipal arms.
